whyUs.title: Why Tyre Vaccine?

howToUse.title: How to Use · 6 Simple Steps
howToUse.subtitle: Easily installable through the valve stem using the provided injector syringe
howToUse.step1Desc: Keep the tyre nozzle position at either 4 o'clock or 8 o'clock position.
howToUse.step2Desc: Remove the valve pin from the nozzle using the tool and completely deflate the tyre.
howToUse.step3Desc: Shake the Tyre Vaccine bottle vigorously for 8 to 10 seconds so rubber, microfibre, and fluid mix evenly.
howToUse.step4Desc: Dip the injector into the bottle, draw required quantity, attach to nozzle, and push gel inside the tyre. Repeat for all wheels.
howToUse.step5Desc: Refix the valve pin securely and inflate the tyre to recommended operating pressure.
howToUse.step6Desc: Drive the vehicle for at least 2 to 3 km immediately to allow centrifugal force to form a uniform protective layer inside.
